name: leafhour-copy-tooling
description: Pinned GET-202 copy lint toolchain: textlint with the official JA technical-writing preset and prh. CI installs it deterministically with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` inside this directory; local runs point LEAFHOUR_TEXTLINT_BIN at an already verified install. It never enters the production function trace and never touches the primary shared node_modules.
